description: The Synthesize partner API from the terminal - every endpoint, plus a usage-push ledger, billing drift detection, and alert-to-ticket tracing no other Gradient tool has.

tools.name: accounts_create
tools.description: Creates an account. Returns array of UpdateMappingPropertyResponse.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: Get Organization Accounts. Optional: accountIds, returnUnmapped. Returns array of GetMappingPropertyResponse.

params.name: accountIds
params.description: Use to fetch specific accounts by id. Defaults to fetching all accounts.

params.name: returnUnmapped
params.description: Use to only return mapped accounts. Defaults to true which returns all accounts.

tools.name: accounts_update
tools.description: Updates 1 or more fields per Account. Returns the updated UpdateMappingPropertyResponse.

tools.name: accounts_update-one
tools.description: Updates 1 or more fields of a single Account. Required: accountId. Optional: description, id, isActive (plus 2 more). Returns the updated UpdateMappingPropertyResponse.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Vendor accountId as provided in the POST request when creating the account.

tools.name: alerting_dispatch
tools.description: Adds an alert to the alerting queue. Required: accountId, alertId, description, priority (default: 1), status (default: 1), title. Optional: dueDateTime, serviceId. Returns the new AlertCreatedDto.

params.name: alertId
params.description: A unique identifier for the Alert.

params.name: priority
params.description: Priority which maps to Ticket. { 1: low, 2: medium, 3: high, 4: very_high }

tools.name: billing_create
tools.description: Set route for adding new unit count for one account, and one service. Subsequent calls will debounce until calls are complete. After which billing views will update. Required: serviceId, unitCount. Optional: no_build, accountId, clientOId. Returns the new ResponseDto.

params.name: no_build
params.description: Skip the billing rebuild for this call (defaults to false); use on all but the last call of a bulk push

params.name: accountId
params.description: Unique Id provided by Vendor. Will be required for future versions.

params.name: clientOId
params.description: DEPRECATED - Use accountId instead: Client Id provided by Gradient.

tools.name: clients_list
tools.description: DEPRECATED - This route is used to get the Client data needed to handling mapping externally. Optional: search, previousId. Returns array of string.

tools.name: integration_get
tools.description: Preferred route for checking credentials. Returns the IntegrationData.

tools.name: integration_update-status
tools.description: Update the integration status for a partner. Set as pending when ready for inital mapping. Set as active when ready for sync. Required: status (default: active). Returns the updated UpdateIntegrationStatusResponse.

tools.name: mappings_create
tools.description: Create Service for a Vendor for an Organization. Returns array of UpdateMappingPropertyResponse.

tools.name: mappings_update
tools.description: Updates 1 or more fields of a single Service. Required: serviceId. Optional: description, id, isActive (plus 2 more). Returns the updated UpdateMappingPropertyResponse.

params.name: serviceId
params.description: Vendor serviceId as provided in the POST request when updating the service.

tools.name: mappings_update-bulk
tools.description: Updates 1 or more fields for each Service. Returns the updated UpdateMappingPropertyResponse.

tools.name: services_create
tools.description: Create Service for a Vendor. Required: category, description, name, subcategory. Optional: supportArticle, supportContact. Returns the new VendorData.

tools.name: services_get
tools.description: Retrieves Vendor with VendorSku[] filtered by service id. Required: serviceId. Returns the GetServiceResponse.

tools.name: ticket_events_check
tools.description: Checks for a ticket Event with the provided messageId to have created a ticket in the PSA. Required: messageId. Returns array of string.

tools.name: vendor_get
tools.description: Get Vendor Details. Returns the GetVendorResponse.

tools.name: vendor_update
tools.description: Update details for a vendor. Optional: description, integrationPortalUrl, name (plus 1 more). Returns the updated UpdateVendorResponse.
